classification_framework: C2 contract predeclared four-level classification; no policy ranking or parameter selection

overall.rationale: All three candidates improve parts of the targeted baseline-failure pattern, but all dependence-aware headline confidence intervals for paired net-return deltas include zero, results vary materially by symbol and period, and premature-exit costs are non-trivial.

P1_BRACKET_TP2_SL1_V1.rationale: P1 rescues some baseline losers and modestly reduces held-green-then-red outcomes, while its headline paired net-return estimate is slightly positive. The uncertainty interval includes zero, the sanity-period and several symbol results deteriorate, and early exits leave material subsequent opportunity.

P2_M5_TRAIL1_AFTER_GAIN1_V1.rationale: P2 has strong rescue rates in the predeclared baseline-failure cohorts and reduces held-green-then-red outcomes. Overall and headline paired net-return estimates are negative, the uncertainty interval includes zero, and results are heterogeneous across symbols.

P3_M5_MOMENTUM_DETERIORATION_V1.rationale: P3 materially reduces held-path surrender and rescues many P0 losers, but it damages more P0 winners than P1 or P2, exits prematurely most often, and has negative overall and headline paired net-return estimates with an uncertainty interval spanning zero.
